mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id FROM tb_sy_user u WHERE u.user_stat_cd='USE' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_sy_user_role ur JOIN tb_sy_role r ON r.role_id=ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id=u.user_id AND r.role_id='ADMIN' AND r.use_yn='Y') ORDER BY CASE WHEN u.user_id='admin' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,u.user_id LIMIT 1
SELECT r.role_id FROM tb_sy_role r JOIN tb_sy_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = 'admin' AND r.role_id = 'ADMIN' AND r.use_yn='Y' ORDER BY r.role_id
SELECT user_nm FROM tb_sy_user WHERE user_id=#{userId}
SELECT r.role_id FROM tb_sy_user_role ur JOIN tb_sy_role r ON r.role_id=ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id=#{userId} AND r.use_yn='Y' ORDER BY r.role_id
